about: The Command line page. {root} is replaced with the folder DE Tech Tool runs from. Every DE command here is tested; Windows commands are the ones DE technicians use on takeovers. Exit codes: 0 done, 1 not finished, 2 blocked or refused.

items.title: Open the window (asks for admin)
items.note: Double-clicking the file does the same.

items.title: Reopen after a restart at the queued step
items.note: Normally the resume task does this at sign-in.

items.title: Open on a page
items.note: Pages: Scan, Dashboard, Discovery, Identity, Security, Apps, Browser, Baseline, Branding, Network, Toolbox, Vendors, AiToolkit, Evidence, Settings.

items.title: Audit only, no window (changes nothing)
items.note: Writes the evidence bundle and a JSON result.

items.title: Plan a takeover without changing anything
items.note: Every step says what it would do.

items.title: Apply a takeover (changes the device)
items.note: Gates still stop anything unsafe; runtime secrets come from -PromptSecrets or RMM DE_SECRET_* variables.

items.title: Dropship first boot
items.note: Refuses a device other than the ordered serial.

items.title: Deploy or update from RMM (sha256-pinned)
items.note: Refuses a zip whose hash does not match.

items.title: Install the newest zip in Downloads
items.note: Unblocks, swaps the install folder safely, keeps the previous copy.

items.title: Check the package is untouched
items.note: FAIL lines name every changed file.

items.title: Install a licence from the Hub
items.note: Or Settings > Licence > Activate this device. A licence works only on the device it was issued for.

items.title: Show licence and build
items.command: Import-Module "{root}\console\modules\DE.Workflow\DE.Workflow.psm1"; Import-DEConsoleModules -Root "{root}\console"; $null = Initialize-DEConsole -Root "{root}\console" -Mode Audit; Get-DELicenseStatus; Get-DEBuildInfo

items.title: Download the Hub's revocation list now
items.command: Import-Module "{root}\console\modules\DE.Workflow\DE.Workflow.psm1"; Import-DEConsoleModules -Root "{root}\console"; $null = Initialize-DEConsole -Root "{root}\console" -Mode Audit; Update-DELicenseRevocations -HubUrl https://techsales.digerati-experts.com
items.note: The tool also does this once per run when the Hub URL is set, and after activation. Offline, the last saved list stays.

items.title: Plan a Toolbox script (changes nothing)
items.note: Every key is listed on the Toolbox page and below.

items.title: Run a Toolbox script for real
items.note: Output goes to the evidence folder as toolbox-*.log.

items.title: See the media build steps without running them
items.note: Needs the Windows ADK and WinPE add-on.

items.title: Write the rescue USB (erases it)
items.note: Use a second NTFS/exFAT USB for profile backups.

items.title: Watermarked release for a technician (test build)
items.note: Adds the build to packaging\out\build-register.csv.

items.title: Signed, enforced release
items.note: Licences required from this build on.

items.title: Dropship kit for an order
items.note: No secrets in the kit; first boot refuses any other device.

groups.title: Code signing and the Intelligence Hub

items.title: Code-signing certificates on this PC
items.command: Get-ChildItem Cert:\CurrentUser\My, Cert:\LocalMachine\My -CodeSigningCert | Where-Object HasPrivateKey | Select-Object Subject, Thumbprint, NotAfter
items.note: A certificate on a USB token shows up while the token is plugged in. Settings > Code signing shows the same list and how to get one.

items.title: Build a signed release
items.note: Signs every script, timestamps the signatures (they stay valid after the certificate expires) and writes integrity.json.

items.title: Check a file's signature
items.note: Valid means signed and unchanged; HashMismatch means the file changed after signing.

items.title: Check the Hub answers
items.note: 200 means the Hub is up. It does not say which release it runs.

items.title: Which release the Hub runs (Hub admin)
items.note: Compare with the merged commit. The Hub server also needs TECHCONSOLE_TO_HUB_SECRET set to the same value as the Tech Tool's signing secret.

items.title: Set the company-branded lock screen (RMM, one step)
items.command: Import-Module "{root}\console\modules\DE.Workflow\DE.Workflow.psm1" -DisableNameChecking; Import-DEConsoleModules -Root "{root}\console"; $null = Initialize-DEConsole -Root "{root}\console" -Mode Apply; Set-DELockScreen -ClientProfile (Get-DEClientProfile -Id alamo) -Confirm:$false
items.note: Users cannot change it, it shows behind the sign-in box, and Windows Spotlight is turned off for every profile. Windows Home ignores lock screen policy. Undo-DELockScreen restores the previous one.

items.title: Check the lock screen
items.command: Import-Module "{root}\console\modules\DE.Workflow\DE.Workflow.psm1" -DisableNameChecking; Import-DEConsoleModules -Root "{root}\console"; $null = Initialize-DEConsole -Root "{root}\console" -Mode Audit; Get-DELockScreenState | Format-List ok, detail, edition
items.note: ok only when the image, the policy and Spotlight-off for every profile are all in place.

items.title: Install the Microsoft modules
items.note: Graph authentication, Exchange Online, Az.

items.title: Connect read-only plus BitLocker key IDs
items.note: Least-privilege scopes per scenario.

items.title: Is the BitLocker key in Entra for this device?
items.note: Key IDs only; the key itself is never requested.

items.title: Remove a device from Autopilot (plan first)
items.note: Drop -WhatIf to do it; refuses ambiguous serials.

items.title: Connect for a migration
items.command: Import-Module "{root}\microsoft\DE-Microsoft-Admin\DE-Microsoft-Admin.psd1"; Connect-DEMicrosoft -TenantId alamo-industries.com -Scenario Read, Users, Migration; Connect-DEExchange -UserPrincipalName jrpetro@alamo-industries.com
items.note: Graph plus Exchange Online; contacts and calendars for other users need the app-only worker.

items.title: Start the project and map a mailbox
items.command: New-DEMigrationProject -ClientName 'Alamo Industries' -TargetDomain alamo-industries.com -ProjectId alamo-mail; Add-DEMigrationUser -ProjectId alamo-mail -SourceAddress helen.x@gmail.com -DestinationAddress helen@alamo-industries.com -Devices HelenU, equip.alamo
items.note: The domain must be verified in the tenant; the destination must be a licensed user mailbox.

items.title: Shared mailbox with Full Access and Send As
items.command: Set-DEMigrationSharedMailbox -ProjectId alamo-mail -Address office@alamo-industries.com -DisplayName Office -Members norma@alamo-industries.com, helen@alamo-industries.com, suzette@alamo-industries.com, mike@alamo-industries.com
items.note: Creates it if missing, grants each member, blocks its own sign-in, then proves it.

items.title: Gmail IMAP preflight
items.note: Use the Gmail app password; it is only held in memory. Records folders, counts and size.

items.title: Pilot, confirm, then the rest
items.command: New-DEMigrationBatch -ProjectId alamo-mail -Type Pilot -Credential (Get-Credential suzette.x@gmail.com); Get-DEMigrationStatus -ProjectId alamo-mail; Confirm-DEMigrationPilot -ProjectId alamo-mail -Technician jrpetro -Note 'checked in Outlook'
items.note: Production batches are refused until a pilot finished cleanly and was confirmed.

items.title: Contacts and calendar from the Google exports
items.command: Import-DEMigrationContacts -ProjectId alamo-mail -SourceAddress helen.x@gmail.com -Path .\contacts.csv; Import-DEMigrationCalendar -ProjectId alamo-mail -SourceAddress helen.x@gmail.com -Path .\helen.ics
items.note: Duplicates are skipped; nobody is invited; a rerun adds nothing twice.

items.title: Find Gmail left on a client PC (every Windows account)
items.note: Run elevated (technician, SYSTEM or RMM): Outlook profiles, Thunderbird and scheduled scripts for every account. Credential Manager is per user, so it is listed as not checked for the others. The Migration page does the same with one button.

items.title: Record a client PC's scan on the project (admin PC)
items.note: Refuses anything that is not a mail-client scan. The device then counts for the bounce diagnostic.

items.title: DNS, final delta, verification
items.command: Test-DEMigrationDns -ProjectId alamo-mail -Server 1.1.1.1; Complete-DEMigrationBatch -ProjectId alamo-mail -BatchName <batch>; Test-DEMigrationMailFlow -ProjectId alamo-mail; Test-DEMigrationMfa -ProjectId alamo-mail
items.note: The final delta is refused until MX points to Microsoft 365.

items.title: Explain a bounce
items.note: Forward, retrying client, bounce of a bounce or new message; names the device and the fix.

items.title: Sign-off, close and the Hub record
items.command: New-DEMigrationSignoff -ProjectId alamo-mail -ApprovedBy 'Mike Daniels' -Decision Approved; Close-DEMigrationProject -ProjectId alamo-mail; Export-DEMigrationRecord -ProjectId alamo-mail -Path .\alamo-mail-record.json
items.note: Approved needs every check passed; closing removes the batches and the credentials Exchange stored.

items.title: Join state (Entra / AD / workplace)
items.note: AzureAdJoined, DomainJoined, DeviceId, TenantName.

items.title: Leave Entra ID (after the migration is verified and the BitLocker key is saved)
items.note: Then restart; dsregcmd /status must show AzureAdJoined : NO.

items.title: BitLocker recovery password and its ID
items.note: Match the Numerical Password ID with JumpCloud before leaving Entra.

items.title: Back up the key to Entra
items.command: $v = Get-BitLockerVolume C:; $p = $v.KeyProtector | Where-Object KeyProtectorType -eq RecoveryPassword; BackupToAAD-BitLockerKeyProtector -MountPoint C: -KeyProtectorId $p.KeyProtectorId
items.note: Only while the device is still Entra-joined.

items.title: Who is signed in, and profile owners
items.command: whoami /upn; Get-CimInstance Win32_UserProfile | Where-Object { -not $_.Special } | Select-Object LocalPath, SID, Loaded
items.note: S-1-12-1-... SIDs are Entra accounts.

items.title: Fix the clock
items.note: A wrong clock breaks HTTPS and sign-in.

items.title: Repair system files
items.note: Can take a long time.
